findings.highlight: I can’t let Caster know that I’m wounded
findings.evidenceJa: キャスター達に俺が負傷している事を悟られる訳にはいかない
findings.governingReading: I cannot let Caster and her side realize I am wounded
findings.explanation: The need to conceal the injury from the opposing group is narrowed to Caster alone.

findings.evidenceJa: あ、と思わず言葉を飲む遠坂
findings.explanation: Rin cutting herself off mid-response becomes a gasp.

findings.evidenceJa: 予想以上に遠坂を納得させるコトが出来た
findings.governingReading: I managed to convince Tohsaka more than I expected
findings.explanation: Shirou’s comic satisfaction at the unexpected effectiveness of his retort is weakened.

findings.evidenceJa: マスターの[ruby text=めいれい char=2]令呪ですもの
findings.governingReading: it is a Master’s Command Spell, after all
findings.explanation: The ruby relation identifying the Command Spell as the Master’s command is collapsed into an ordinary order.

findings.highlight: Saber and Caster begin their attack
findings.evidenceJa: セイバーの剣と、キャスターの魔術が鯉口を切る
findings.governingReading: Saber’s sword and Caster’s magecraft slip free of their sheaths
findings.explanation: The source’s weapon-centered unsheathing metaphor is flattened and changes the grammatical actors.

findings.highlight: How can a mere human defend against it
findings.governingReading: with one instant left to live
findings.explanation: The narration’s exact imminent-death beat disappears from the translated surrounding sentence.
